model.name: The board never marks a task RIPE on a SIBLING's Test — shared-requirement tasks are RIPE-SHARED (manual verify-owner-first), never auto-flip on a sibling's evidence
model.description: The scoreboard must NOT compute a task as RIPE (flip-ready) using a SIBLING task's passing Test. Measured defect: T37.4.3 was flagged RIPE purely because its sibling T37.4.2 (sharing requirement R37.11) had a passing Test (a7f3c1e8), while T37.4.3's OWN dominance-lint facet was RED + expert-blocked — the board proposed a task backed by SOMEONE ELSE's evidence into Tron's batch (the T40.5 borrowed-credit disease, but the BOARD is the one proposing it). The naive fix (key on Impl-ownership) is MEASURED-IMPOSSIBLE: b5f72641 has no sharedByTasks field. Use the STRUCTURAL signal instead: a task whose coveredRequirement is SHARED by sibling tasks is downgraded to RIPE-SHARED, which requires manual verify-owner-first and can NEVER auto-flip on a sibling's Test — it reaches true RIPE only when its OWN distinct-intent facet is evidenced.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The scoreboard NEVER marks a task RIPE (flip-ready) using a SIBLING task's Test: a task whose coveredRequirement is shared by sibling tasks is NOT auto-RIPE from the requirement's aggregate green.
Such a task is downgraded to a distinct RIPE-SHARED state = requires manual verify-owner-first (confirm the task's OWN facet is evidenced); it can NEVER auto-flip on a sibling's passing Test.

The signal is STRUCTURAL (coveredRequirement shared by >1 task), NOT Impl-ownership — measured-impossible: the shared Impl (e.g. b5f72641) has no sharedByTasks field, so Impl-ownership cannot be the key. Derive shared-ness from the tasks' coveredRequirements, not the Impl.

STUB-MUST-FAIL bite (else the guard certifies nothing): construct a sibling with a passing Test on the shared requirement -> assert the OTHER sibling is NOT marked RIPE (it is RIPE-SHARED); a guard that would auto-RIPE it -> RED. Proves a sibling's passing Test does NOT mark the task ripe.

A shared-requirement task reaches TRUE RIPE only when its OWN distinct-intent Test/facet passes (verify-owner-first), never the requirement's aggregate coverage — matches the shared-Impl-two-distinct-Tests anti-double-credit pattern (T40.5 discipline) applied to the board.
